subject: SKU consolidation & channel uplift timing for Azure private offer
messages:
From: Samir Patel <procurement@acme-corp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure private offer — SKU consolidation and reseller uplift question

Hi Aditya,

Quick question from procurement as we prepare the private offer: our finance team wants to reduce SKU proliferation on the Azure PO and prefers a consolidated platform SKU plus a single optional premium add-on rather than the six separate SKUs in the original quote. Can Redwood support a consolidated SKU mapping for the private offer?

Separately, our reseller (ResellCo) is asking what uplift they should charge on top of the list price when they pass through the private offer to our internal reseller channel — they want a clear recommended percentage for margin planning. Our goal is to have commercial sign-off and the PO out by 6/30.

Attached: procurement template (acme-procurement-sheet.xlsx).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, Acme Analytics

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private offer — SKU consolidation and reseller uplift question

Samir — thanks for the note and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can consolidate into a small set of offer SKUs for the private offer and provide recommended channel uplift ranges. Proposed approach below and request a confirmation on expected committed ARR so we can size the bands properly.

Suggested SKU mapping (high level):
- RDW-Platform (base): covers S0–S2 capacity/instances; single unit for platform usage
- RDW-HT (add-on): high-throughput compute/priority queue (optional)
- RDW-Emb (unit): embedding compute unit (metered)

Pricing mechanics:
- Provide list price per consolidated SKU and a tiered discount ladder tied to committed 12/24-month spend.
- For ResellCo pass-through, typical recommended uplift is in the 8–12% range (gross) depending on services attached. If ResellCo is only passing through without professional services, aim lower (8%). If they provide deployment/support, 12% or dealer fee is reasonable.

Open items from our side:
- Confirm committed ARR for 12/24 month bands (this drives private offer thresholds).
- Confirm whether tax-inclusive pricing is needed (Acme legal/procurement preference).
- Want ResellCo on a quick 15-min sync to confirm their margin ask and whether they invoice net or gross.

I attached a concise SKU mapping PDF so procurement can circulate to finance: sku-mapping-proposal.pdf.

Next steps:
1) Samir — confirm commit band and whether a single consolidated SKU is OK.
2) Samir/ResellCo — confirm uplift target (we recommended 8–12%).
3) Naomi — can you draft the private-offer pricing bands and an initial DocuSign-ready T&Cs bundle once we have the commit number?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: sku-mapping-proposal.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Azure private offer — SKU consolidation and reseller uplift question

Looping in internally — some quick points from channel ops perspective:

- I agree with the 8–12% uplift range but want to flag regional tax and marketplace fee carve-outs. In a few Azure deals we've seen marketplace fee + VAT push the effective uplift higher if partners invoice gross.
- If Acme requires a clean pass-through (no partner margin on top of the private-offer list price), we should offer a slightly higher list price to the customer and reserve a fixed reseller commission (e.g., 6–8% net) rather than a percentage uplift. That preserves accounting clarity.
- Suggest an internal optional clause: reseller can choose either gross uplift OR fixed commission; document both in the private-offer appendix.

Naomi — can you run a quick net-revenue workup showing the difference (example numbers) between: (a) list price + 10% reseller uplift vs (b) list price + 0% uplift with 7% fixed commission to ResellCo? Need that for procurement to present to finance.

I propose we aim to finalize wording by 6/26 so legal can package the DocuSign packet for signature by 6/30.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ellie Torres <partner_ops@resellco.io>
Cc: Samir Patel <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Azure private offer — SKU consolidation and reseller uplift question

Marissa / Aditya / Ellie / Samir — attached is a simple net revenue workup showing three scenarios:

1) Base consolidated SKU at $100k list with ResellCo gross uplift of 10%
2) Base consolidated SKU at $108k list with ResellCo fixed commission of 7% (net to Redwood)
3) Tiered discount band for 12/24 month commit with blended reseller commission

Highlights from the attached spreadsheet (channel-net-rev-workup.xlsx):
- Scenario (1) yields higher gross buyer price but simpler pass-through for ResellCo; Redwood net is list / (1 + uplift) after marketplace fees — less predictable if partner invoices gross including VAT.
- Scenario (2) keeps buyer-facing price stable and makes Redwood net predictable (list minus fixed commission).
- If Acme is sensitive to sticker price in their internal vendor scorecard, scenario (2) keeps sticker lower for procurement but requires us to increase list by ~8% to preserve Redwood net.

Ellie — can you confirm whether ResellCo prefers (a) to invoice Acme with a visible uplift line item, or (b) invoice at a single consolidated price and take a commission from Redwood? That will determine the DocuSign appendix language.

Samir — if you can confirm target commit (e.g., $1.2M/yr vs $2.4M/yr) I will produce the final private-offer banding and a DocuSign packet template. I can do that by EOD 6/25 if we have the commit.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Finance Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachment: channel-net-rev-workup.xlsx
